collections.name: Designer Lightweight
collections.title: DESIGNER - LIGHTWEIGHT
collections.description: Contemporary fibreglass planters in sleek profiles. Ideal for modern spaces, interior landscaping, and minimalist architectural designs. Lightweight construction makes installation effortless.

products.title: DOME
products.description: Don't be fooled by look alikes — the Dome Pot is a true round planter, not an oval. Its perfectly symmetrical shape is inspired by the form of a stadium, which is exactly how it earned the name Dome.

products.title: TEA CUP
products.description: Inspired by the graceful silhouette of a classic tea cup, this planter brings a refined, elegant look to your space. Unlike the softer curves of an egg style planter, Tea Cup features a slightly pointier base and lifted profile.

products.title: WADDLE
products.description: Meet the Waddle planter, a custom favourite and a true crowd-pleaser with its soft, egg-inspired curves. Its playful, rounded silhouette brings a relaxed, sculptural touch to any space.

products.title: FOAMY
products.description: The FOAMY planter takes its name from the familiar foam roller, with a distinctive surface that mimics its textured, rhythmic pattern. This unique ripple and straight look gives the pot depth, movement, and a tactile finish.

products.title: TEAR DROP
products.description: Stand out from the ordinary with the Tear Drop planter — a striking design that flips tradition on its head. Inspired by a reverse triangle or pyramid-like silhouette, Tear Drop brings architectural flair.

products.title: DOOR STOP
products.description: A contemporary wedge-shaped planter designed for modern spaces.

products.title: RIPPLE TUBE
products.description: Textured cylindrical planter with ripple detail.

products.title: WOBBLE
products.description: Contemporary wobble planter with unique tilted design.

products.title: PIPE
products.description: Planter box with modern cylindrical design.

products.title: GIANT WOK
products.description: The Giant Wok – Large Low Bowl Planter (Fibreglass & Polyresin). Bring sculptural elegance to your garden or outdoor space with The Giant Wok – a large low bowl planter designed for impact.

products.title: EGGY
products.description: Eggy Planter – Timeless Egg-Shape Style with Straighter Edges. Meet the Eggy planter, the stylish cousin to our beloved Waddle.
